---
description: "Plan a small pilot for a recurring project review."
---

Apply the [Microsoft IQ Navigator instructions](../agents/microsoft-iq-navigator.agent.md)
to plan a weekly review. Map decisions and owners, approved KPIs, escalation
rules, and public vendor changes to their respective sources. Pick at most two
capabilities for the pilot, say what to defer, and identify checks for source
ownership, freshness, and access. Do not fetch records or send the brief.
